title: Trajectories of Glucocorticoid-Therapy in Early Rheumatoid Arthritis: Protocol for a Systematic Review
author: Andriko Palmowski
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bpyfmptn

steps.title: Define Study Eligibility Criteria
steps.instruction: Identify observational cohort studies (CS) published between Jan 01, 2005 and the present that enroll early (or methotrexate-naive) RA patients who start or take systemic glucocorticoids (GCs) at baseline and report at least one outcome at a minimum of two time points.

steps.title: Execute Literature Search
steps.instruction: Perform a search using the PICOS mnemonic and the following search string: (Rheumatoid[Title] OR Arthritis, Rheumatoid[MeSh:NoExp]) AND (early[title/abstract] OR naïve[title/abstract]) AND (Cortison*[title/abstract] OR Predniso*[title/abstract] OR Cortico*[title/abstract] OR Glucocort*[title/abstract] OR Steroid*[title/abstract] OR Glucocorticoids[MeSh:NoExp]) AND (Cohort[Title/Abstract] OR Longitudinal[Title/Abstract] OR Prospective[Title/Abstract] OR Registry[Title/Abstract] OR Longitudinal Studies[Mesh:NoExp] OR Cohort Studies[Mesh:NoExp] OR Registries[Mesh:NoExp]) AND 2005/01/01:2021/01/01[dp] NOT (random*[Title] OR randomized controlled trial[pt]) NOT (review[Title] or review[pt]).

steps.title: Extract Outcome Data
steps.instruction: Collect data for the following outcomes at baseline, 3, 6, 9, 12, and 24 months: mean/median dose of prednisone equivalent, proportion of patients who could discontinue GCs, and proportion of patients who could reduce GCs.

steps.title: Perform Meta-Analysis
steps.instruction: Pool the results using meta-analysis, incorporating mixed effects meta-regression to assess the change over time for each outcome.
